about.metaDescription: The story of the Indonesian Film Festival, a non-profit, student-run festival in Melbourne.
title: About
Festival
story: The Indonesian Film Festival (IFF) is a non-profit festival run entirely by students in Melbourne. Since 2006, it has brought the best of Indonesian cinema to Australian audiences, usually at ACMI in Federation Square.
Each year a new committee programs the festival from scratch: choosing films, inviting filmmakers, and bringing the community together.
We exist to share Indonesian stories, support emerging filmmakers through our Short Film Competition, and connect the Indonesian community in Melbourne with everyone curious about its cinema.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To establish IFF as a reputable and lasting platform for Indonesian cinema, fostering a space where films, filmmakers, and conversations can thrive and reach wide audiences.

mission.title: Mission
items: Enhancing audience experiences through innovative event features.
Maintaining and strengthening relationships with external stakeholders through transparency and active communication.
Building a united team prioritizing clear communication and collaboration.
